signature: SUBROUTINE DLASRT( ID, N, D, INFO )

params.name: id
params.reference:
-   `= 'I'`: sort D in increasing order;
-   `= 'D'`: sort D in decreasing order.

params.name: N
params.reference: The length of the array D.

params.name: d
params.reference: On entry, the array to be sorted. On exit, D has been sorted into increasing order (`D(1)` \<= ... \<= `D(N)` ) or into decreasing order (`D(1)` \>= ... \>= `D(N)` ), depending on `ID`.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
